description: This file defines the Metadata class and related nested classes for managing status information, services, channels, servers, subsystems, and RPC configurations within the Thunder PluginHost namespace. It includes class definitions, methods, and data structures for plugin metadata, subsystem management, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Main class holding status info, services, channels, servers, subsystems, and RPC data, with methods for clearing data and generating instance/thread IDs.

classes.name: Metadata::Service
classes.description: Represents a plugin service with state, version, module, observers, and interface versions.

classes.name: Metadata::Channel
classes.description: Represents a communication channel with remote endpoint, state, activity status, ID, and name.

classes.name: Metadata::Server
classes.description: Contains server minions and pending requests, with methods to clear data.

classes.name: Metadata::Minion
classes.description: Represents a server minion with ID, job, and run count.

classes.name: Metadata::SubSystem
classes.description: Manages a collection of subsystems with add and clear functionalities.

classes.name: Metadata::COMRPC
classes.description: Holds remote link and proxy data for RPC communication.

classes.name: IMetadata
classes.description: Interface for plugin metadata, including instance ID and subsystem precondition, termination, and control lists.

classes.name: MetadataType
classes.description: Template class implementing IMetadata, providing plugin version info and subsystem requirements.

classes.name: Metadata
classes.description: Template class extending Core::PublishedServiceType to create plugin metadata services.

methods.name: InstanceId
methods.description: Converts a pointer or non-pointer type to Core::instance_id.

methods.name: ThreadId
methods.description: Converts an instance ID back to a thread ID pointer or type.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears internal data structures of the Metadata object.
